correctness.rationale: For the consecutive Stern pair the two children are the invertible maps L(a,b)=(a,a+b), R(a,b)=(a+b,b) modulo five. L fixes the initial pair (0,1), so leading zeroes preserve indexing. Lexicographic length-r words concatenate the L block and then the R block. A prefix completed in the second block has weight S_r(Lq) plus its internal prefix; this proves the three updates including empty and full prefixes. The independent finite recomputation confirms S_5=S_1, A_28=A_16−4 and B_28=B_16+4 at all 24 states. The S update propagates its period four, hence also period twelve. A constant translation of both arguments of either extremum passes unchanged through min/max, so the all-state extrema certificate propagates from r=16 by induction. The listed base pairs and witness discrepancies match. Consecutive dyadic bounds squeeze the running absolute maximum to (log_2 X)/3+O(1).
residual_risks: The recomputation checks finite integer premises and examples, not the universal claim by itself; the latter uses the recurrence induction. This is not formal verification.
